propositions: Project code-review criteria declared in repository overlays are dropped at criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission seams

Project criteria must be threaded through five production-file seams: resolver (ids.py), fan-in attribution (batch_runner.py, gate_dispatch.py), repository-effective routing (workflow_ops.py), eval/calibration admission (eval_solver.py, eval.py), and CLI admission (_llm_eval_commands.py)
Project code-review criteria must execute once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and respect repository-effective Pass-3 routing
The project-criterion runtime extension contract must be documented and proven by end-to-end unit tests covering resolver, fan-in, routing, and parity
An active project code-review criterion must be admitted to eval/calibration and CLI while preserving no-overlay parity with 13 built-in packaged criteria
